company.distributes: Packaged snacks, drinks, gifts, flowers, magazines and everyday convenience items in its hospital convenience stores (Zouki Convenience and Convenience Plus)
company.channels_supplied: Patients, visitors and staff through convenience stores and retail precincts in hospitals such as the Royal Melbourne, Royal Women's and St George hospitals, across 34 sites in Victoria, NSW, Queensland and the ACT
what_they_do_well: Won the 10-year contract to run all retail outlets in the new Bendigo Health building, its 15th Victorian hospital contract.
Takes head leases for hospital retail precincts in Victoria, NSW and the ACT and runs them under its own store brands.
company.fit_rationale: Zouki holds head leases on whole hospital retail precincts and runs its own branded convenience stores, buying centrally for many hospital sites. Its convenience stores sell snacks and gifts to patients, visitors and staff, a natural shelf for sugar free sweets and chocolate. Sugar free brands carried are not named on its website.
